notes: Historical posting quality, not a fake-job detector or a measure of today's vacancies.
Observations, exact text groups and representative quality records use different grains. A text group is not a verified unique vacancy.
Quality is the latest representative group score, not a historical score for each observation. Missing numeric experience is unknown, not zero.
Numeric disclosure includes usable minimum, maximum or publisher median pay. Currency and pay period are kept separate.
Title and skill classification use limited rules; unclassified postings are retained. Remote permission is known only where recorded.
validation: 123,849 observations and 119,041 exact text groups reconcile with qa_summary.json.
36,073 numeric-salary observations; 4,808 repeated observations; 73 of 2,919 entry-title groups have parsed 2+ years.
All 42 role/seniority selections are computed independently from the exported posting and group facts.
